title: Why You See It Everywhere Now

visual.description: Macro close-up of a human eye blinking with detail on the iris.

vo.en: That specific car model or rare word you just discovered?
vo.fr: Cette voiture précise ou ce mot rare que tu viens d'apprendre ?

visual.description: A man's hand flipping through the pages of a thick dictionary.

vo.en: Suddenly it’s popping up on every street corner, book, and screen you see.
vo.fr: Soudain, tu les vois partout, à chaque coin de rue et sur tous tes écrans.

visual.description: Top-down view of a busy city intersection with many different cars moving.

vo.en: It feels like a glitch in the matrix, but it's actually the Baader-Meinhof phenomenon.
vo.fr: C'est l'illusion de fréquence, aussi appelée le phénomène Baader-Meinhof.

visual.description: Abstract digital animation of glowing neural networks connecting in a blue void.

vo.en: Your brain is constantly bombarded with data, so it filters out almost everything to save energy.
vo.fr: Ton cerveau filtre des milliers d'informations chaque seconde pour ne pas saturer.

visual.description: Macro shot of sand falling through an hourglass, showing individual grains.

vo.en: Once you label something as new or interesting, your subconscious starts highlighting every instance of it.
vo.fr: Dès qu'une info devient importante, ton inconscient se met à la traquer activement.

visual.description: A man in a field looking through binoculars, scanning the horizon.

vo.en: These things were always there; your brain simply stopped treating them as background noise.
vo.fr: Tout était déjà là, mais ton esprit l'ignorait simplement jusqu'à maintenant.

visual.description: Time-lapse of a crowded train station with people moving as colorful blurs.

vo.en: Follow to spot your mental blindspots and understand why...
vo.fr: Abonne-toi pour démasquer tes biais cognitifs et comprendre que...

visual.description: Profile view of a man smiling and tapping his temple with one finger.
